query:
SELECT 
  CHAR_LENGTH(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(wowReportJson, '$.lifeHistoryPattern'))) as lhp_length,
  SUBSTRING(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(wowReportJson, '$.lifeHistoryPattern')), 1, 500) as lhp_start
FROM analysis_reports
WHERE clientId = 810001
LIMIT 1;
